query: NVIDIA GeForce RTX revenue Q1 fiscal 2027
normalized: 2027 fiscal geforce nvidia q1 revenue rtx

output.content:
NVIDIA did **not separately disclose GeForce RTX revenue** in Q1 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended April 26, 2026); it replaced the former Gaming reporting line with an **Edge Computing** category. [[1]] 

Edge Computing revenue—covering a broader set of products and therefore **not a GeForce RTX-only figure**—was **$6.4 billion**, up **10% quarter over quarter** and **29% year over year**. [[1]] 

For context, NVIDIA had reported **$3.8 billion of Gaming revenue** in Q1 fiscal 2026, but that prior category is not directly comparable with FY27’s broader Edge Computing line. [[2]] [[1]]
